title: Show a member how many times each link on their personal Spotlight was pressed

source.ref: Follow-up named in LIVE-1953; Daniel said go 2026-11-02

detail: A press on a link of a personal Spotlight sends one identity-free beacon to the existing /api/spotlight/click route, which writes a row to the new member_spotlight_link_clicks table (service role only, no visitor data) after checking the Spotlight is published and the link is on the page. The editor shows each link's presses over the last 30 days. Migration 20270346028500 must be applied to production before merge.

verify.evidence: Beacon, route branch, table migration, counted public links and the editor count are present.
